# Copilot instructions

This file exists only because GitHub Copilot looks for it by convention (Copilot Chat
automatically includes its content in every request made in this repository). All real content —
commands, conventions, guardrails — lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), the vendor-agnostic
source of truth every AI coding agent working in this repository should read. Don't duplicate
content here; if something needs to change, change it in `AGENTS.md`.
